feeds.title: Stuffed Crocodile
feeds.description: This is a private blog about roleplaying games. The Pen and Paper tabletop variant is played with a group of friends, some dice, pencils, ungodly amounts of unhealthy snacks, and a lot of fantasy. Not the other kind that involves handcuffs and schoolgirl uniforms or similar things. I am a German gamer living and working in Poland and mostly playing in English. I also write about it on this blog. I mostly play Labyrinth Lord, Traveller, and Das Schwarze Auge, but mix in some other systems as well.

The site offers a platform for gamers to explore various game options, purchase gaming supplies, and engage with the tabletop gaming community through forums, articles, and events.
